payload.text: hv, 2026-10-17 evening: devbin goes PUBLIC as soon as it is proven safe, by a NEW repository built from one audited commit, never by opening this one (GitHub still serves replaced commits, 5 of them carrying deny-list hits). Ruled: (1) the public repository carries the PRODUCT ONLY, by an allow-list of paths (bin/, lib/, tests/, docs/, packaging/, .github/, README, LICENSE, CHANGELOG and RELEASES after review), with NO intent/; (2) it carries an OPEN-SOURCE licence, which one still to choose; (3) this repository STAYS PRIVATE as the workroom, keeping intent/ and the whole history, and the public one receives product snapshots. The audit before publishing: allow-list, a widened name scan, a secret scanner, two independent reads of every file (vc and dc), the full suite and a public brew install on the fresh commit, then hv's approval naming the contents. Not put to hv again.
